name: Nachtrodeln am Hoadl
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The illuminated sled run at **Hoadl** is a fun experience for both kids and adults. After a cozy ascent via the chairlift, you zoom down the 4-kilometer-long track on a sled into the valley below. Floodlights cast a magical glow over the route—pure adrenaline and winter fun!
